purpose: bounded investigation using Mythroot deciding factors, configurable evidence neighborhoods, grounded claim candidates, question coverage, and auditable second-pass targeting

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

evidence_quality.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. Destroying the whole nest for a one-time haul is easier but ends the relationship; leaving it standing rewards a return visit next season, which is the likely origin of "managed wild colony" behavior — people learning which hollow trunks host productive colonies and returning to them rather than raiding indiscriminately

evidence_claims.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.

mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.

evidence_quality.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. Destroying the whole nest for a one-time haul is easier but ends the relationship; leaving it standing rewards a return visit next season, which is the likely origin of "managed wild colony" behavior — people learning which hollow trunks host productive colonies and returning to them rather than raiding indiscriminately

evidence_claims.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

evidence_quality.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. Destroying the whole nest for a one-time haul is easier but ends the relationship; leaving it standing rewards a return visit next season, which is the likely origin of "managed wild colony" behavior — people learning which hollow trunks host productive colonies and returning to them rather than raiding indiscriminately

evidence_claims.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. Destroying the whole nest for a one-time haul is easier but ends the relationship; leaving it standing rewards a return visit next season, which is the likely origin of "managed wild colony" behavior — people learning which hollow trunks host productive colonies and returning to them rather than raiding indiscriminately

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

evidence_claims.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.

mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

evidence_claims.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. Destroying the whole nest for a one-time haul is easier but ends the relationship; leaving it standing rewards a return visit next season, which is the likely origin of "managed wild colony" behavior — people learning which hollow trunks host productive colonies and returning to them rather than raiding indiscriminately

mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

evidence_quality.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. Destroying the whole nest for a one-time haul is easier but ends the relationship; leaving it standing rewards a return visit next season, which is the likely origin of "managed wild colony" behavior — people learning which hollow trunks host productive colonies and returning to them rather than raiding indiscriminately

evidence_claims.passage: - **Basingrazer (018)** and **Plateauhorn (019)** — both ruled out: 2.5–3 tonnes, matriarchal megaherds built around outrunning nothing and fighting everything. Too large to feed, house, or restrain with pre-agricultural tools, and their defense strategy (stand and fight with horns/head-shield) doesn't de-escalate around humans the way domestication needs. - **Thicketback (012)** — considered: right size range (300–400kg), but its defense is scatter-and-freeze in dense cover, and its small family bands don't generalize a stable dominance hierarchy a human could step into. Better fit for a future small-livestock candidate than a pack/milk animal.

evidence_claims.passage: **Human harvest:** A mature colony keeps a working surplus beyond what it needs to survive a bloom gap; that surplus, concentrated in the outer/newer storage cells, can be removed without touching the older, deeper cells the colony actually depends on — meaning a colony can be harvested from repeatedly across a season if a person takes only the outer surplus and leaves the core untouched. mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.

mythroot_principles.purpose_before_inventory: Information matters when it changes or supports a worldbuilding decision; completeness is not measured by filling every possible field.
mythroot_principles.scope_and_scale_matter: The same subject may legitimately exist at continental, regional, settlement, group, or individual scale.
mythroot_principles.depth_follows_importance: Depth should follow story importance, world importance, and intended application rather than uniform detail everywhere.
mythroot_principles.coherence_is_systemic: Geography, settlement, economy, politics, law, history, culture, daily life, and ecology can constrain or explain one another.
mythroot_principles.canon_has_states: Hard canon, flexible canon, open space, and unknown are different information states.
mythroot_principles.absence_is_not_automatically_error: An undocumented area may be intentionally open, genuinely unknown, or actually missing; these states must be distinguished.
mythroot_principles.relationship_requires_deciding_factors: A relationship label is justified by the factors that explain why the relationship exists, not by lexical overlap alone.
mythroot_principles.evidence_has_provenance: Claims should remain traceable to their source and context.
mythroot_principles.human_validation_is_authoritative: CORE may identify, compare, infer, and escalate, but it does not silently alter canon or promote hypotheses to canon.
